description:
Christmas morning, 1945. A farmhouse in Fayetteville, West Virginia burns to the ground — and five Sodder children vanish without a trace. No bones, no remains, nothing. The official story said 'accidental fire.' But the phone line was cut before the blaze, the ladder was missing, and witnesses swore they saw the children alive afterwards.

In this documentary, Dark Case Files walks through every strange detail: the sabotage, the sightings across the country, the billboard the family kept up for decades — and the mysterious photograph that arrived 23 years later. Honestly, the deeper I went into this case, the less the official story held together. In my opinion, this was never just a fire.

Dark Case Files brings you America's most baffling unsolved crimes — carefully researched, documentary-style. Subscribe so you never miss a case.
